request.queryParametersTemplate:
{"query": "fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter isNull(dt.davis.is_duplicate) OR not(dt.davis.is_duplicate)
| fieldsAdd duration = coalesce(event.end, now()) - event.start,
    affected_entities_count = arraySize(affected_entity_ids),
    affected_entity_ids = affected_entity_ids,
    affected_entity_names = affected_entity_names,
    smartscape.affected_entity.ids = smartscape.affected_entity.ids,
    event_count = arraySize(dt.davis.event_ids),
    affected_users_count = dt.davis.affected_users_count,
    problem_id = event.id
| fields `display_id`, `event.name`, `event.description`, `event.status`, `event.category`, `event.start`, `event.end`, `root_cause_entity_id`, `root_cause_entity_name`, `duration`, `affected_entities_count`, `affected_entity_ids`, `affected_entity_names`, `smartscape.affected_entity.ids`, `affected_users_count`, `problem_id`, `dt.davis.impact_level`, `dt.davis.mute.status`, `dt.davis.mute.user`, `entity_tags`, `event_count`, `event.severity`, `maintenance.is_under_maintenance`
| sort `event.status` asc, `event.start` desc
| fieldsRename
    event_name = `event.name`,
    event_description = `event.description`,
    event_status = `event.status`,
    event_category = `event.category`,
    event_start = `event.start`,
    event_end = `event.end`,
    smartscape_affected_entity_ids = `smartscape.affected_entity.ids`,
    dt_davis_impact_level = `dt.davis.impact_level`,
    dt_davis_mute_status = `dt.davis.mute.status`,
    dt_davis_mute_user = `dt.davis.mute.user`,
    event_severity = `event.severity`,
    maintenance_is_under_maintenance = `maintenance.is_under_maintenance`", "defaultTimeframeStart": "{_QueryWindowStartTime}", "defaultTimeframeEnd": "{_QueryWindowEndTime}", "maxResultRecords": 100000, "requestTimeoutMilliseconds": 60000}
